def test_async_fallback_includes_failed_attempt_trace(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    """Failed traces from the first route must appear in the async success path."""
    value = "mock-credential-value"
    monkeypatch.setenv("NVIDIA_API_KEY", value)
    monkeypatch.setenv("GOOGLE_API_KEY", value)

    router = LLMRouter(
        [
            RouterProfile(

            ),
            RouterProfile(

            ),
        ]

        captured.append(list(kwargs.get("traces", [])))
